note: Alberta Parks prairie campground on Little Bow Reservoir, south and east of Vulcan via Hwys 23, 529 and 845, run by MIM Management Group: two open loops whose outer rows back onto the reservoir (Loop N sites 4-14 and Loop S sites 4-17 are tagged Near Water), shade from scattered trees, a boat launch and a day-use area. Reservoir levels vary through the year; watch for submerged islands and shallow shores. Firewood from the campground operator. Pike fishing, canoeing, water-skiing, swimming and birding. --Claude
